title: Route Dispatcher

scenario.intro: Three routes run the {{resource}} desk: one vehicle by number, the special /{{resource}}/{{special}} board, and a search. They're written, but in the wrong order, untyped, and the search ignores its filters.
scenario.goal: Dispatch every request to the right handler: typed IDs, the fixed path before the parameter path, and a search that reads `line` and `limit`.

objective: Every request reaches the handler that was meant for it.
rules: `/{{resource}}/<number>` finds one vehicle; the number is an `int` (anything else bounces with 422).
`/{{resource}}/{{special}}` always reaches the {{special}} handler, never the number route.

tests.name: POST is not a route here

hints.text: FastAPI checks routes top to bottom and takes the first path that matches. Which path also matches /{{resource}}/{{special}}?
Put the fixed path first, give vehicle_id a type, and let the search take `line` and `limit` as parameters.
Something like: @app.get("/{{resource}}/{{special}}") above @app.get("/{{resource}}/{vehicle_id}") with vehicle_id: int.

dialogue.start: Dispatcher on duty. Every request, the right platform.
dialogue.success: Perfect dispatch! Not one request on the wrong platform.
dialogue.fail: Some requests reached the wrong handler. Check route order and types.
